about_the_game:
A baby fears nothing but a toddler begins to feel the crushing weight of humanity. Stand on uncertain footing against the darkness and keep a wobbly step ahead of all the things you fear. The Terrified Toddler Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and one player icon.   

 

 The Terrified Toddler Pack includes the following: 

  • Cap’n Binky Suit 

  • Major Binky Suit 

  • Fuzzy Wuzzy cell item 

  • African Mask cell item 

  • Tribal Shield cell item 

  • Bed Sheet cell item 

  • A player icon
